examples.en: It was much more enjoyable than I had expected.
examples.zh: 它比我原先想的要令人愉快得多。

examples.en: The exhibition is an enjoyable and, ultimately, life-affirming experience.
examples.zh: 这个展览是一次不但令人愉快，而且还鼓舞人心的体验。

examples.en: The staff should make sure the kids have an enjoyable and educational day.
examples.zh: 教职员要确保孩子们度过愉快的、有教育意义的一天。
